name: Dangerous!
summary: At Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia has marked four Hillsbrad humans for execution. She calls them enemies of the Forsaken for killing their people and striking at supplies.

sections.title: A Matter of Retribution
sections.body: Across the Hillsbrad Foothills, the fighting is brutal and personal. High Executor Darthalia and the Forsaken garrison at Tarren Mill see ordinary Hillsbrad citizens as deadly foes. A wanted notice names four people whose resistance has killed Forsaken and cost them valuable shipments from the Undercity.

sections.title: Targets of Tarren Mill
sections.body: The bounty names Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, who killed Deathguard Toma; Citizen Wilkes, who murdered Apothecary Eli; Miner Hackett, who killed Deathstalker Fry; and Farmer Kalaba, who sabotaged supply convoys from the Undercity. Each works from a different pocket of Hillsbrad resistance and remains elusive amid the wider conflict.

faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia, commander of the Forsaken forces at Tarren Mill, issued the bounty against four prominent Hillsbrad humans.

faq.q: Why are these specific humans wanted?
faq.answer: Each has struck the Forsaken: Clerk Horrace Whitesteed killed Deathguard Toma, Citizen Wilkes murdered Apothecary Eli, Miner Hackett killed Deathstalker Fry, and Farmer Kalaba ambushed essential supplies from the Undercity.
All four are scattered across Hillsbrad Foothills, among the human settlements, farms, and mines.

faq.q: What is the strategic purpose of this contract?
faq.answer: The contract answers the killings and aims to cripple local human resistance, protecting Forsaken patrols and supply lines between Tarren Mill and the Undercity.

faq.q: Does this connect to the Battle of Hillsbrad?
faq.answer: Yes. The targets live in the farms, mines, and town centers Forsaken forces assault during the wider Battle of Hillsbrad offensive.

faq.q: Who turns in the bounty once they are slain?
faq.answer: Bring proof of their deaths directly to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

angles.text: As an Undead, avenging fallen Deathguards, Apothecaries, and Deathstalkers is a grim point of pride for a loyal servant of the Dark Lady.
As Horde, you help secure Hillsbrad Foothills by breaking the human militia's fiercest figures and making Horde movements through the region safer.
As a Rogue, tracking concealed leaders in hostile territory echoes the covert work of Deathstalker Fry, whose death this contract avenges.
